_howToEdit: Recurring events use 'weekly' (days: 0=Sun..6=Sat) or 'monthly' (nth + day). One-off events use 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD) and disappear automatically once the date has passed. Categories: music, sports, trivia, special, seasonal. Rebuild with `node build.mjs`.
